503711.name: Diakovce

503746.name: Dolné Saliby

503771.name: Horné Saliby

503835.name: Jelka
503835.note: The archived 2019 presidential election notice has only voter information; no okrsky document found. 503932.name: Neded

503959.name: Pata

503991.name: Selice

504017.name: Sládkovičovo

504025.name: Šaľa

504050.name: Šoporňa

The Internet Archive was online.

504068.name: Tešedíkovo
504068.note: The archived Prezidentské voľby 2019 pages (2019-06-19, Hungarian 2019-07-17) list no okrsky document (results, candidates, e-mail address, OVK delegation, voter roll); no PDF of the site before 2021 is archived. Every okrsky document Tešedíkovo published (referendum 2023, NR SR 2023, president 2024, EP 2024, referendum 2026, municipal/regional 2026) gives each of its 3 okrsky only its polling station (Dom kultúry č. 860; MŠ č. 153; Školská jedáleň ZŠ č. 974), never which houses vote where. 504092.name: Trnovec nad Váhom
504092.note: The presidential-elections page of 2019 is archived only as 'Podstránka nenájdená' (2019-07-20); no other 2019 okrsky page is archived. The Internet Archive answered mostly HTTP 429/connection refused; retried with pauses.

504106.name: Trstice
504106.note: No okrsky document for the presidential election of 16 March 2019 on trstice.sk. Its notice-board items are the generic voter information (item 89), the decision of the Speaker (item 90), the e-mail address for delegating commission members (item 97) and the candidate list; none names the okrsky or their house numbers, and no radio announcement of March 2019 is archived. 504114.name: Váhovce
504114.note: The old website vahovce.sk, archived page "Voľby prezidenta SR" (2019-08-18), lists the information for voters (SK/HU), the e-mail address for OVK delegations, the candidates and the OVK minutes; no okrsky decision. Internet Archive was slow/intermittent (HTTP 503/timeouts) but answered after retries.

504122.name: Veľká Mača
504122.note: Veľká Mača's okrsky documents (2023 NRSR, 2024 president, 2024 EP, 2026 municipal/regional) only create 2 okrsky and name their polling stations, both in the same building (Obecný úrad, Sereďská 137: zasadačka / sobášna sieň); none assigns streets or house numbers. The municipality has one part and no street names, so the okrsky cannot be inferred from stations. 504131.name: Veľké Úľany

504203.name: Senica
504203.note: The city's election articles are reused for each new vote (the municipal and regional pages now show 2026 only), so this vote's documents are no longer linked; older files survive only under unknown article/file ids. 504238.name: Borský Mikuláš

504254.name: Brestovec

504351.name: Gbely

504459.name: Kopčany
504459.note: The current elections page starts with 2018 (and lacks 2019); the archived old 2019 pages link 'Volebné okrsky a volebná miestnosť' files for the presidential and EP elections, but those files are gone (404) and were not captured by the Internet Archive; nothing for the 2017 regional elections was found.

504513.name: Kúty
504513.note: Kúty had 2 okrsky then; no document setting them (streets per okrsok) found on kuty.sk live or in the Internet Archive (CDX of the whole domain checked). 504742.name: Radošovce

504769.name: Rohožník

504891.name: Šaštín-Stráže

504947.name: Veľké Leváre

504980.name: Závod

504998.name: Topoľčany

505048.name: Ludanice

505315.name: Partizánske

505421.name: Radošina

505498.name: Solčany

506036.name: Horné Srnie

506125.name: Kočovce

506141.name: Kostolné

506150.name: Krajné

506265.name: Moravské Lieskové

Another vote's notice is not this vote's.

506273.name: Motešice

506427.name: Podolie

506508.name: Soblahov

506559.name: Trenčianska Teplá
506559.note: The website's election pages (2022–2026) hold only OVK minutes and results, no okrsky announcement for this vote; the referendum 2026 page links a file on trencin.sk (another municipality's website), not usable. 506567.name: Trenčianska Turná
506567.note: The current website (new CMS since 2022) has elections pages only from 2022 on. 506745.name: Trnava

506818.name: Boleráz
506818.note: The live notice board (current and archive records, searched for okrsk/volieb/miestnost) keeps election records only from 2022 on, besides result notices of 2018-2020; no okrsky document of this vote. 506842.name: Brestovany

506923.name: Dolná Krupá

506991.name: Drahovce
506991.note: The archived page of the 2019 presidential election links only the delegation address; no okrsky document.

507067.name: Horné Orešany
507067.note: The presidential 2019 notice 'Volebné okrsky a volebné miestnosti' (30.01.2019) names 2 okrsky and their rooms in the cultural house but not their territory; the village has one part.

507121.name: Chtelnica

507199.name: Kočín-Lančár

507253.name: Leopoldov
507253.note: The 2019 presidential page links only an undated 'Zoznam volebných okrskov a ulíc v nich' (old letterhead) with 3 okrsky; the vote had 4 (the 4th, about 175 voters, being the prison ÚVTOS a ÚVV Leopoldov as in later decisions), so it is not this vote's full decision. 507288.name: Madunice

507342.name: Moravany nad Váhom
507342.note: Moravany nad Váhom's live notice board lists only current items; probing its board files (e_download.php obsah150-620) found an okrsky decision only for the NR SR election 2023 (and 2022, 2026 municipal); none for this vote. 507555.name: Smolenice
507555.note: No okrsky document for this vote: the website's elections pages (and their Internet Archive captures, old and new site) list for it only voters' information, voting-card forms, e-mail notices and results.

507601.name: Špačince
507601.note: The municipality's elections pages hold only results and candidate lists (2018–2020) or link to the ministry's website (2023–2024); no okrsky document of any vote was found on the website, its notice archive, or in the Internet Archive (CDX returned nothing).

507636.name: Šúrovce

545651.note: The website (new CMS since 2023) keeps no okrsky document of this vote and the Internet Archive has no capture of one (its captures of the domain begin in 2020 and hold only 2023 referendum, 2024 presidential and 2026 municipal okrsky notices). The 2024 and 2026 notices make each part of the municipality one okrsok (1 Čuklasovce, 2 Horné Držkovce, 3 Dolné Držkovce), but no document of this vote was found.

545741.name: Trenčianske Stankovce
545741.note: The current website's elections pages cover only 2022-2026; the notice board's archive records (searched for okrsk, volebn, voľb, miestnost, utvoren and listed in full) have for this vote only other election notices (vyhlásenie, informácie pre voliča, delegovanie, výsledky), no okrsky document; the Internet Archive holds no elections page or okrsky document of the domain from 2019.

546640.name: Dolný Lieskov
546640.note: The website's elections documents (Dokumenty – Voľby) hold okrsky documents for the NR SR 2023, EP 2024 and 2026 votes only; none for the presidential election of 2019. The Internet Archive refused connections (offline for us).

555509.name: Zálesie
555509.note: The elections section of the website lists okrsky decisions for 2016 (one okrsok), 2017, EP 2019 and later votes, but none for the presidential election of 2019.

555576.name: Trhová Hradská
555576.note: The municipality's website (live and as archived since 2017) publishes for the votes only commission minutes, delegation addresses and voter information; no document creating the okrsky (utvorenie volebných okrskov / zoznam ulíc) for any vote 2017–2026 was found; a web search found none either.

555754.name: Matúškovo
555754.note: Matúškovo's okrsky documents (2023 NR SR 'Zverejnenie volebných okrskov a volebných miestností' of 27.06.2023, and the same for 2024 and 2026) give each okrsok only its polling station, both in the same building (Centrum voľného času, Matúškovo č. 513: okrsok 1 predsieň, okrsok 2 zasadačka); the municipality has one part and no streets in the register, so no rules can be derived from them (prompt: stations only and not one per part -> not_found). No document assigning streets or house numbers to the okrsky was found on the website, live or in the Internet Archive's CDX of matuskovo.sk 2017-2026.

555878.name: Horná Kráľová
555878.note: The page of the 2019 presidential election lists only the election announcement, voter information and the delegation notice; no okrsky document in the media library or the Internet Archive.

556157.name: Jacovce
556157.note: The archived 2019 presidential page links 'Oznam o určení volebných okrskov' (docs/aktuality/2019/002.pdf), but the Internet Archive has no capture of that PDF and it answers 404 live.

556483.name: Križovany nad Dudváhom
556483.note: The presidential elections page (live) lists for 2019 only the decision, e-mail address, voter information, voting-card forms, candidates and results; no okrsky document. The 2024 document is for the 2024 vote only.

557293.name: Vlkanová
557293.note: The archived 2019 presidential election page links only voter information, the decision calling the vote and the announcement; no okrsky document. Old site gone (404).

557358.name: Vrútky
557358.note: No okrsky document of this vote found: the town's current website (vrutky.sk) keeps vote pages only from the 2022 elections on, and the Internet Archive's sparse captures of the old site (2016-2021, textsvk/ and download/ files) hold only 2018 election results, no okrsky notice.

558320.name: Ivanka pri Nitre
558320.note: No 2019 presidential document: the website (WordPress since 2019) and the Archive hold none. The only okrsky documents on ivankaprinitre.sk are of 2022-11 (referendum 2023), 2023-06 (NR SR 2023), 2024-01 (president 2024), 2024-03 (EP 2024), giving only the three polling stations (all in the Kultúrny dom), and 2026-07 (municipal/regional 2026-10-24, with streets). Internet Archive was reachable.

559784.name: Turňa nad Bodvou
559784.note: No okrsky decision for this vote on the website's notice board (which keeps the 2022, 2022-11 referendum, 2024 presidential and 2026 decisions) or in the Internet Archive: the archived 2018–2020 election pages list only voter information and candidate lists (their 2018 'oznam' PDFs are 404 and not archived), and no decision for 2017, 2019, 2023-09, 2024-06 or the 2026 referendum is published.

560103.name: Vysoké Tatry
560103.note: The town's notice board keeps only current items (the October 2026 elections and the July 2026 referendum's minutes, no okrsky announcement); earlier announcements were removed and survive only in the Internet Archive, which was offline (the 2022 documents in this repository come from it). The host rate-limits requests (HTTP 429), so fetching was kept minimal.

560154.name: Smižany
560154.note: No okrsky document of the presidential election 2019 (page has no okrsky document) on the website; Internet Archive offline; the host rate-limits requests.

580317.name: Utekáč
580317.note: The elections page links only 'Oznamenie_okrsky.pdf', which states that the obec has 2 okrsky and gives each only its polling station (č. 1 Utekáč 848 sála MKS; č. 2 Utekáč – Drahová 1051), no streets or parts. The register has a single part (Utekáč), so the okrsky cannot be assigned by part; no document defines which addresses vote where. The Internet Archive (offline at first, reachable later) holds for obecutekac.sk in 2017 only captures of older election pages (NR SR 2016, municipal 2014) and no okrsky document.

580554.name: Čenkovce
580554.note: The website's elections page lists only the 2026 referendum article, whose files (results, information for voters, decision on the referendum) include no okrsky document; older votes are not on the current site. The site then refused our connections (blocked) and the Internet Archive refused connections too, so the notice board and older captures could not be checked; the maintainer may retry.

580899.name: Lužianky
580899.note: For the presidential election of 2019 the obec's site keeps only the results of both rounds (articles of 18.3.2019 and 3.4.2019); the notice board's archive starts in April 2019. No okrsky document of this vote live or in the Internet Archive (no captures of luzianky.sk between May 2018 and July 2019).

581020.name: Hrnčiarovce nad Parnou
581020.note: The archived page for the presidential election of 2019 (volby-prezidenta-sr-2019.html) lists only the voter information and the e-mail address for the okrsok commission; no okrsky document was found live or in the Internet Archive; the municipality has one part and its later decisions (2022-2026) only name one polling station, Kultúrny dom, Farská 37, for every okrsok, without streets.

581399.name: Banka
581399.note: The notice board (current and archive) and the site search find okrsky documents only for the 2022 elections and the 2023 referendum; no okrsky document of the presidential election of 2019 found. The Internet Archive refused connections (offline for us).

582093.name: Vyšný Medzev
582093.note: No okrsky document for the 2019 presidential election is on the website or in the Internet Archive; the archived 2019 pages and files are only voter information.

582816.name: Žitavany
582816.note: The live website (www.zitavany.sk, Voľby - Referendum) keeps vote pages only from the 2022 elections on; the oldest okrsky document there is the referendum's of 2023. In the Internet Archive (CDX of zitavany.sk 2017–2022 and of the old notice board) no okrsky document of 2017–2020 is captured: the 'Voľby VÚC 2017' page is captured empty (2018-12-30, 2021-05-06); the 2018 notice-board entry 'Voľby do orgánov samosprávy obcí 2018' links only the voters' information and the decision calling the elections; the 2018 obvody notice concerns council obvody only; the 2019 notice board lists EP 2019 voter-information and voting-certificate entries, never captured, and no okrsky entry; the 2020 by-election page links only the obvody/seats decision and results. Web search found nothing else. The Archive was intermittently offline but answered after retries. No page of the presidential election 2019 is captured.

598186.name: Košice-Staré Mesto
598186.note: The district's elections page and site search hold documents from 2024 on only (presidential and EP elections 2024, referendum and elections 2026); nothing of this vote. The Internet Archive was unreachable (connection refused) throughout.

598682.name: Košice-Dargovských hrdinov
598682.note: No okrsky document of the presidential election 2019 on the website; Internet Archive offline.

599093.name: Košice-Barca
599093.note: The old site's page 'Voľby prezidenta 2019' (archived 2019-08-21) links 'Určenie volebných okrskov' (/images/Urenie volebnch okrskov 2019.pdf), but the PDF was never captured (only a 2024 redirect) and is gone from the live site.

599794.name: Košice-Krásna
599794.note: The website's elections page starts with the 2022 elections and the old notice board (to 8/2021) holds nothing on elections; no okrsky document of the presidential election of 2019 found. The Internet Archive refused connections (offline for us).

599824.name: Košice-Juh
599824.note: The district's elections page linked an okrsky document for several votes (e.g. download/33319 for the referendum 2023, download/35781 for the NR SR election 2023, download/37199 for 2024), but the website has deleted them ("Download does not exist") and the Internet Archive kept none of them; for 2017–2020 the archived elections pages link no okrsky document. Only the 2026 documents remain online.

599972.name: Košice-Luník IX
599972.note: The live website www.mclunik9.sk refused connections on 2026-10-31. In the Internet Archive, the old site's notice board (uradna_elektronicka_tabula, captured 2019-07-16, listing every item from 2015 to 26.3.2019) and the WordPress board that replaced it in 2020 (oznamenia, captured 2020-10-28; elections page dokumenty/volby empty) list no 'utvorenie volebných okrskov' for any vote before 2022: for the presidential election of 2019 they post only nothing at all. The archive's list of the domain's PDFs has no okrsky document before the 2022 one (Utvorenie-volebnych-okrskov-a-urcenie-volebnej-miestnosti-v-MC-KE-LIX.pdf, dated 3.8.2022), which may not be used for this vote.
